snippet.title: CoffeeShop Simulator – Trailer | Free Demo Out Now on Steam ☕
snippet.description:
☕ The free demo of CoffeeShop Simulator is out now on Steam!
▶ Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162390/CoffeeShop_Simulator/
❤ Wishlist the full game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162390/CoffeeShop_Simulator/

Put on your apron and run your own little café, alone behind the counter. Grind, tamp, pull the shot, steam the milk, pour a bit of latte art… every drink is made by hand, from the beans to the customer's table.

IN THE FREE DEMO
• 3 days behind the counter, starting with a guided first day
• 3 addresses to choose from, each with its own furnished café
• 7 recipes: espresso, americano, lungo, filter coffee, latte, macchiato and cappuccino
• Customers who order at the till, wait at the pass or sit down in the café
• Dishes, sponge and cleaning between two rushes
• A real end of the day: last orders at 8:30 pm, then night falls
• 13 languages, prices in your own currency

IN THE FULL GAME (Early Access)
• Build mode: walls, doors, windows, furniture and decoration
• Tea bar, matcha, bubble tea, smoothies, syrups, iced drinks and pastries
• Equipment to buy, meal deals, goals and the road to the "Neighbourhood Café"

Your demo save carries over to the full game.

💬 Join the community: https://discord.gg/zu4XytPDR8
Feedback, bugs, ideas: I read every message!

A solo indie game made with Unreal Engine 5.

#CoffeeShopSimulator #CozyGames #IndieGame #Barista #SimulationGame #SteamDemo #Coffee
